items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So one day, God Bless the Dead, Jesse Price came to New York. First person he come to see was Lady Day. That's where I met Jesse Price.

ctx.x: And I stopped in St. Louis, by the way. And I should have turned around and come back home then. I ran into the monster -- Jimmy Blanton. He was playing at Sportsmen's Lodge. with Jeter and Pillars, And if he played a solo, Floyd Smith would play it along with him as a duet. And if Floyd played a solo, he would play it along with Floyd. That's how well they were, you know. WILLARD: Attuned to each other. Simmons: Yeah, and I said, "Wow." And he had played with Fate Marable. Now,

Fate Marable, he must be old as water, because people are still playing with him. Jesse Price played with him when he was a young man. The late Jesse Price. You know? Jimmy Blanton played with Fate Marable.
So, I went on to Chicago, and what did I do it for? I should have went on to New York.
